property_summary: For any valid input where transfer completes without reverting, the function must return true; the bug returns false even when the external calls succeed.
For any input where the external calls succeed, the transfer function must return true; the mutant returns false regardless.

For any valid input where the external calls to caddress succeed, the return value of transfer must equal the logical AND of all internal call successes (i.e., true when all succeed); the mutant always returns false regardless.
For any admissible input where the call does not revert, the return value of transfer must be true; the mutant returns false even though all external calls succeeded.
For any input where all external calls succeed, calling transfer returns true; the mutant always returns false.
